blocks.raw: You can enable and configure in-app messages within your application for both iOS and Android.
blocks.text: You can enable and configure in-app messages within your application for both iOS and Android.

blocks.raw: To enable in-app messaging for iOS, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To enable in-app messaging for iOS, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. Enable in-app messaging by setting the `enable_in_app_messaging` parameter to `true` in your `hydra-config.plist` file.
2. Add an Image Set named `inAppPlaceholder` in your project's `images.xcassets`. This image will serve as a placeholder when an in-app message does not include an image.
